verdict: Mr. Badar Sami looks like the final boss of failing students by 0.1 percent and ignoring canvas messages until after final grades are submitted.
detailedQuote: Wearing a stiff charcoal blazer that looks like it was purchased alongside his original 2005 syllabus, he radiates the pure energy of an instructor who locks the lecture hall door at 8:01 AM sharp. His entire ensemble screams 'I read 120 text-heavy slides per class with zero breaks and treat office hours as an affront to my personal space.'

inventory.name: Black Wire-Rim Spectacles of Judgment
inventory.description: Thin rectangular frames engineered exclusively to render maximum side-eye while denying requests for extra credit.

inventory.name: Dark Charcoal Blazer of Bureaucratic Sadism
inventory.description: A shapeless, soul-crushing dark suit jacket that hasn't seen a dry cleaner or an updated teaching assistant since the mid-2010s.

inventory.name: Light Blue Button-Up Shirt of Unearned Authority
inventory.description: A starch-deprived dress shirt so painfully devoid of personality that it depresses the room's average GPA just by existing.
